g.title: EPP_QSP
g.text: Erythropoietic Protoporphyria (EPP) / X-Linked Protoporphyria (XLP) — Mechanistic QSP Map
FECH loss-of-function (EPP) or ALAS2 gain-of-function (XLP) → protoporphyrin IX OVERFLOW → 400-410 nm photoexcitation → ¹O₂ → burning pain
THE CENTRAL TENSION: PPIX is simultaneously the PRODUCT of the pathway and the SUBSTRATE of the broken enzyme,
so every intervention acts on a RATIO (supply ÷ disposal) and the SIGN of its effect is a property of WHICH ARM IS RATE-LIMITING, NOT OF THE DRUG.

Three sign flips fall out and are computed, not assumed: (1) Zn-protoporphyrin rises in XLP but not in EPP · (2) iron helps XLP and harms EPP · (3) shielding × source-reduction is MULTIPLICATIVE, not additive.

Therapy axes: MC1R agonists raise the OPTICAL DENOMINATOR (afamelanotide implant, dersimelagon PO) · GlyT1 inhibition lowers the SUBSTRATE NUMERATOR (bitopertin) · hepatobiliary rescue interrupts a SADDLE-NODE runaway

g.title: cluster_genetics
g.text: 1. Genetic lesion — a THRESHOLD disease, not a dosage disease (penetrance needs the low-expression allele in trans)

g.title: cluster_heme
g.text: 2. Erythroid heme biosynthesis — upstream flux is INTACT and keeps pushing against a closed terminal step

g.title: cluster_iron
g.text: 3. Iron — enters at THREE points with OPPOSITE signs; the net effect is computed, never assumed

g.title: cluster_distribution
g.text: 4. PPIX distribution — hydrophobic, ZERO renal clearance, exactly ONE exit (bile): a single-exit topology

g.title: cluster_photophysics
g.text: 5. Photophysics — a Soret band at 400-410 nm is why window glass, clouds and sunscreen all fail

g.title: cluster_injury
g.text: 6. Cutaneous injury cascade — ¹O₂ lasts 3 µs, the pain lasts 3 days: persistence lives in SLOW state variables, not in the photon

g.title: cluster_clinical
g.text: 7. Clinical phenotype & trial endpoints — every one of these is a THRESHOLD-CROSSING TIME, not a level

g.title: cluster_liver
g.text: 8. Protoporphyric hepatopathy — a SADDLE-NODE BIFURCATION on the only exit route (2-5% lifetime, but ~1/5 of those die)

g.title: cluster_mc1r
g.text: 9. MC1R → eumelanin — the ONLY drug axis that changes the optical denominator (and it never touches PPIX)

g.title: cluster_pk
g.text: 10. Drug pharmacokinetics — an implant, two oral small molecules, an IV, and two non-absorbed gut agents

g.title: cluster_pd
g.text: 11. Pharmacodynamics — TWO ORTHOGONAL AXES: shielding (denominator) × source-reduction (numerator). Their product is the dose.

g.title: cluster_control
g.text: 12. The patient as a feedback controller — prodrome is the SENSOR, retreat is the ACTUATOR, and human reaction time is the LOOP DELAY

g.title: cluster_ddx
g.text: 13. Biochemical signature & differential — the Zn-PP FRACTION separates EPP from XLP from lead/iron deficiency

g.title: cluster_readout
g.text: 14. QSP model read-outs — the numbers the mrgsolve model emits

g.title: Fe_paradox
g.text: EPP: FECH broken → extra Fe mostly feeds ALAS2 → PPIX ↑ (HARM)
XLP: FECH intact but starved → extra Fe feeds disposal → PPIX ↓ (BENEFIT)

g.title: Slow_accrual
g.text: by slowing dose accrual it makes the SAME
human delay non-limiting → fewer FULL reactions
even at equal total sun exposure

g.text: the most effective 'drug' ever used in EPP —
and the one with the worst QoL cost
